title: Decision-Level Hijacking: Injecting Cognitive Bias into Large Language Models via Bit-Flip Attacks

bias_targets.methodology: Sentiment analysis of model outputs using a fine-tuned DistilBERT classifier to measure positive and negative polarity toward competing commercial brands (e.g., Coca-Cola vs. Pepsi) in response to recommendation prompts.

Using a specialized sentiment classifier (climate-attitude-LM) to measure the stance tendency of model outputs on factually contested topics (specifically climate change), evaluating shifts from scientific consensus to skepticism.
